title: Dependency injection — concept map
intro: ASP.NET Core ships a built-in dependency injection (DI) container. Register services in IServiceCollection at startup, inject via constructors. Three lifetimes — singleton, scoped, transient — with strict rules: longer cannot depend on shorter. The captive dependency trap (scoped inside singleton) is the #1 interview question. IServiceScopeFactory fixes background work. Keyed DI (.NET 8+) names multiple implementations.

overviewDiagram.title: DI container in a Web API request
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  START[Program.cs\nbuilder.Services.Add*] --> BUILD[Build IServiceProvider\nValidateOnBuild]
  BUILD --> REQ[HTTP Request\nCreateScope]
  REQ --> RESOLVE[Resolve handler deps\nscoped + singleton + transient]
  RESOLVE --> HANDLER[Controller or Minimal API handler]
  HANDLER --> DISPOSE[Dispose scope\nDbContext released]
  BUILD --> BG[BackgroundService\nsingleton]
  BG --> FACTORY[IServiceScopeFactory\nCreateScope per work item]
  FACTORY --> DISPOSE2[Dispose scope]

conceptCards.title: DI fundamentals
conceptCards.summary: IServiceCollection registers; IServiceProvider resolves. Constructor injection only. Register abstractions (IOrderService), not concretions.

conceptCards.title: Service lifetimes
conceptCards.summary: Singleton (app), Scoped (per request), Transient (per resolution). DbContext is always scoped. Longer cannot depend on shorter.

conceptCards.title: Captive dependency trap
conceptCards.summary: Singleton holds scoped reference — scoped lives forever. Cross-tenant leaks, ObjectDisposedException. ValidateOnBuild catches at startup.

conceptCards.title: Keyed DI (.NET 8+)
conceptCards.summary: Multiple implementations under a key. [FromKeyedServices("stripe")] on parameters. GetRequiredKeyedService for dynamic resolution.

conceptCards.title: IServiceScopeFactory
conceptCards.summary: Singleton-safe factory for scoped work in BackgroundService. CreateScope per message/tick/batch. Outbox dispatcher pattern.

conceptCards.title: Registration patterns
conceptCards.summary: TryAdd for library defaults. Factory delegates for IOptions. Scrutor decorators. Open generic IRepository<>.

conceptCards.title: DI in minimal APIs
conceptCards.summary: Handler parameters auto-resolve from request scope. MapGroup + IEndpointFilter for per-route cross-cutting. WebApplicationFactory for test overrides.
